description: Modular three-phase power analyzers (96 mm panel), Modbus RTU or TCP through a communication module
notes: FC03 or FC04 read (the same values), FC06 and FC10 write; at most 125 registers per read.
Floats and 64-bit integers are low word first (bytes high first in each word).

Firmware codes in the protocol: X = WM30, Y = WM40, Z = WM20, followed by the revision. Registers without a note are on both WM30 and WM40; most min, max and demand max values and the odd/even harmonics are WM40 only.
Not in this map: harmonic FFT blocks (0x0600-0x08D0), harmonic phase angles (0x0900), alarm set-up blocks (0x1050, 0x1500), per-variable min/max resets (0x3200) and module settings other than RS485.
